summary: Market mood is defensive and risk-off, with Bitcoin facing possible retests of recent lows while some analysts expect a rebound after the Anthropic IPO and liquidity rotation. Ethereum appears relatively resilient against Bitcoin, but large ETH transfers linked to a North Korea-linked hack create elevated downside risk; oil and yields are expected to weaken if risk assets recover.[8][10][6]
